items.title: Classification of indecomposable reductive spherical pairs in nonsimple semisimple groups in arbitrary characteristic
items.author: Friedrich Knop; Gerhard Röhrle
items.difficulty_reason: The full arbitrary-characteristic classification requires soundness by characteristic reduction and the characteristic-two family, generic stabilizer/module analysis and completeness via simple factors, diagonal embeddings and graphical decomposition of indecomposable pairs. All original connectedness, nonsimplicity, indecomposability and broad isogeny conventions including Frobenius/exceptional isogenies retained. Old hard lemma is a generic-stabilizer support step, not the complete tabulated classification. No row, special-characteristic case or supporting theorem separately counted.

primary.label: Complete original indecomposable nonsimple spherical-pair classification theorem

proof_spans.label: Complete original reductions, generic stabilizers, soundness and completeness proofs with all native graphical decomposition

contexts.label: Original algebraically closed/arbitrary-characteristic spherical-pair setup and scope
Original broad isogeny convention and acknowledgments
